title: Good Lattice Quotients at Depth Zero
body_html:
Good Lattice Quotients at Depth Zero

For a vertex \(x\) represented by a good lattice \(L\), the two residual spaces are \[ \ell=L/L^\ast p_D,\qquad \ell^\ast=L^\ast/L. \] They carry induced finite-field hermitian forms, and \[ G_x/G_{x,0+}\simeq U(\ell)\times U(\ell^\ast). \] The Witt classes of \(\ell\) and \(\ell^\ast\) depend only on the Witt class of \(V\), not on the chosen good lattice.
